This is a well-studied problem in sphere packing and geometry. The exact values of $k(n)$ are known for small $n$, but for larger $n$, only bounds are known.

The known bounds for $k(n)$ are generally derived from linear programming methods (e.g., the Delsarte linear programming bound) or geometric constructions.
